title: Chapter 231: Literary And Martial Arts Academy
content:
Chapter 231: Literary And Martial Arts Academy

At this moment, Ye Teng finally realized the seriousness of the matter and hurriedly cried and begged for mercy.

But it was obviously a bit late at this time.

Xiao Yin shook his head.

"Tiandi Academy doesn't need someone like you."

Suddenly, Ye Teng's face looked ugly, but for a moment, he did not dare to refute.

After pondering for a while, Ye Teng said in a deep voice: "Teacher, I am a member of the ancient Ye clan. Even if you don't care about my face, you still have to care about my Ye clan's face, right?"

Ancient Leaf Clan.

This is the absolute top force in the Immortal Realm.

Like the previous Xiao clan, even if it has not been completed, it can still be a first-class force, let alone the Ye clan in a strong period.

However, Xiao Yin was still expressionless.

"Are you Ye tribe very strong?"

The current Ye clan is probably beaten by the Xiao clan so hard that he dare not go out.

Otherwise, Ye Teng would not have been unaware of the family matters now.

It is estimated that the Ye tribe has forgotten Ye Teng.

The few dogs behind Ye Teng were frightened and lowered their heads tightly, not even dared to fart, for fear that Xiao Yin would notice him.

But obviously, Xiao Yin did not forget these few people who had just shouted.

"There are you guys, let's get out together."

Hearing this, the faces of the few people changed.

"Teacher, don't."

"Teacher, who is perfect, please give students another chance."

Several people beg for mercy quickly.

One of them even secretly took out a music transmission note.

Xiao Yin naturally saw it, but he didn't react.

"Come."

Xiao Yin shouted lightly.

The next moment, three powerful people from the Tiandi Academy suddenly appeared in the field.

"Blow these people out."

"clear."

The three strong men nodded respectfully at Xiao Yin, and then looked at Ye Teng and the others with bad eyes.

"You guys, let's go."

Hearing this, Ye Teng and others looked ugly.

And at this moment, an old man dressed in the outskirts' tutor's costume walked towards the place.

When Ye Teng and his friends saw the old man, their expressions lit up.

"Teacher, teacher!"

Several people quickly waved to the old man.

"What's going on?"

The old man walked over, glanced around, and then said in a deep voice.

His face is not angry and powerful.

"Teacher, please help the students, we will be expelled from the academy."

Ye Teng immediately walked forward and hugged the old man's thigh and cried bitterly.

He was just a small force. He was lucky enough to enter the academy and thought he would usher in his peak.

But after entering the academy, I found that the competition in the academy was fierce.

There is even the risk of being eliminated and leaving the academy.

There was no way, he couldn't compete with others, so he had to choose to follow a person like Ye Teng who came from a big force, and temporarily avoided leaving the academy.

And now, he is going to be expelled from the academy, how can he accept it?

Hearing this, the old man frowned slightly.

"Who is going to expel you?"

"It's me."

Xiao Yin stood up and said indifferently.

Suddenly, the old man looked at Xiao Yin.

"Hmm? You, why do I think you look so familiar?"

The old man looked at Xiao Yin and frowned.

Hearing this, Xiao Yin smiled faintly, "I haven't seen you for a million years. Why, Mr. Chen doesn't recognize me anymore?"

"you!!"

At this moment, the old man's heart was stormy.

She actually,

After seeing the inner courtyard mentor token in Xiao Yin's hand, the old man immediately understood everything.

Immediately, the old man turned his head and looked at Ye Teng and others.

"You guys were fired."

"What!"

"Teacher, I am a member of the Ye tribe. Have you forgotten the explanation of the strong men of my tribe?"

Ye Teng immediately reminded.

Hearing this, the old man shook his head slightly.

"Ye Teng, you, the Ye tribe, are no longer in the safe position. In the future, you should be more low-key."

As he said that, the old man threw Ye Teng a jade talisman directly.

It records what happened to the Xiao clan in recent days, including the other three clans.

Ye Teng was a little confused when he listened to the old man.

But when he saw the information in the jade talisman, he was stunned like lightning.

The Xiao clan is rising, and the twelve peak powerhouses in the Immortal Emperor realm.

The Leaf tribe was surrounded.

The next moment, Ye Teng sat on the ground with his butt, his eyes were lost, and he murmured, "No, impossible, impossible."

The old man looked at Ye Teng's appearance and sighed slightly.

Then the three strong men from the academy took Ye Teng and others off.

The wailing sound spread farther and farther, until it disappeared.

"I really didn't expect that you, a girl, could come back."

At this time, the old man looked at Xiao Yin and said with a complicated expression.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin smiled and said nothing.

"Are these two your students?"

Xiao Yin nodded.

Finally, Xiao Yin left the inner courtyard and took Lu Xue and Xiao Luo to the inner courtyard.

Tiandi Academy can only be considered a real academy when it reaches the inner courtyard.

Each of the students and mentors there is a demonic and powerful man from outside forces.

They kept heading deep into the academy, and there were no obstacles along the way. In this way, the three of them came to a canyon.

Looking at the canyon in front of him, Xiao Yin's eyes were filled with emotion.

On the side, Xiao Luo was a little yearning.

This is the place he has always wanted to enter since he entered the academy.

In fact, I had already had the opportunity to enter the inner courtyard in advance.

But he didn't do that, but chose to rely on his own efforts to improve himself step by step until he met the requirements of the inner courtyard.

Immortal Saint Realm.

But now, I was directly brought in by Xiao Yin.

"Entering the inner courtyard early has the benefit of entering early. This is a good opportunity, and you don't need to waste it."

Hearing Xiao Yin's teachings, Xiao Luo nodded awkwardly.

In fact, he had long regretted it, just because he was young and frivolous.

If I had already entered the inner courtyard, I might have been the Immortal Saint Realm now. With the resources and connections I obtained in the inner courtyard, I would not have to rush back alone at the moment of the family's life and death, and I would not be able to help a little. busy.

On the side, Lu Xue looked at the canyon in front of her, "Is it the inner courtyard inside?"

Xiao Yin nodded.

"The inner courtyard and the outer courtyard are two worlds. In the inner courtyard, the competition is very fierce. Not only do you need to continuously improve your strength, but if you want to obtain more resources, you also need to make the ranking."

"Play the ranking?"

Lu Xue was puzzled, what's the matter?

"There are three lists in the inner courtyard of the academy, one is the literary list, one is the martial arts list, and the other is the evil list."

"If you want to play the rankings, you still need to meet the conditions for playing the rankings. For example, only people from the Literary Academy can play the list, while only people from the Martial Academy can play the list."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was shocked and said, "What? The Academy of Civil and Military Academy??"

"Why are there so many academy divided?"

Lu Xue was shocked at this moment.

I thought the academy would be divided into inner and outer courtyards.

Unexpectedly, the inner court was divided into clerks and martial arts colleges.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin explained: "Some people learn literature in the academy and some learn martial arts. Everyone has their own choices, so there are also the Academy of Literature and the Academy of Martial Arts."

"Sister Xiao Yin, what kind of courtyard are you from?"

Lu Xue asked weakly.

"Martial Arts Academy."
